about: Verified facts about game data and memory, with their status PER GAME and a check that re-runs them. A finding verified on one game is a hypothesis on the other: run verify_finding there and record the result here (status, date, where, evidence). Statuses: verified | differs | unverified | n/a. Check kinds: correlate (memory_correlate finds a bit equal to `expect` with 0 counterexamples), stored (the label's value is stored in the range), eval (eval_path value matches `expect`), code (find_field_access: a decompiled excerpt of the struct's code contains every `expectAll` string - needs Ghidra and a snapshot of that game's exe), manual (an experiment: follow `how`).

findings.title: Stash tab Flags bit 6 = the tab has at least one affinity
findings.subject: ServerStashTab (ServerStashTabOffsets)

poe1.evidence: memory_correlate over 71 tabs: 11 with affinity vs 60 without, 0 counterexamples; tabs with 1, 2 and 4 affinities; seen clearing when a tab lost its last affinity

findings.title: Stash tab Flags bit 1 = the tab has a type (TabType != 0, i.e. not a Normal tab)
findings.subject: ServerStashTab (ServerStashTabOffsets)

poe1.evidence: memory_correlate over 71 tabs: 63 typed vs 8 Normal, 0 counterexamples

findings.title: Stash tab Flags is a 16-bit field at +61; bit 6 gates the 4-byte Affinity at +63 in the tab's network (de)serializer
findings.subject: ServerStashTab (ServerStashTabOffsets.Flags, Affinity)

poe1.evidence: find_field_access: serializer FUN_141d4d020 / deserializer FUN_141d4d1f0 read and write 2 bytes at +0x3D and 'if (flags & 0x40) read 4 bytes at +0x3F'; UI FUN_140a8e150 tests 0x40 to show the affinity in bold. The HUD maps Flags as 1 byte, so +62 is its high byte

findings.title: Stash tab Flags bit 0 = remove-only tab
findings.subject: ServerStashTab (ServerStashTabOffsets.Flags)

poe1.evidence: set on exactly the 4 tabs the game lists as '(Remove-only)' (16, 1, 2, 5) and on no other of 71; UI code FUN_140a8e150 tests it

check.how: List tabs with Flags & 1 (run_csharp over ServerData.PlayerStashTabs, Read<ushort>(Address + 61)) and compare with the tabs the game labels '(Remove-only)' in the stash tab list.

findings.title: Stash tab Flags bit 5 = child tab (a page inside e.g. the Map stash); +58 (u16, unmapped) = parent tab index, 0xFFFF for top-level tabs
findings.subject: ServerStashTab

poe1.evidence: client conversion FUN_14025ac30 takes the tab's parent link from +0x3A when bit 5 is clear and from its caller when set; all 27 Map stash pages have bit 5 and +58 = 23 (the Map stash tab's index); all 44 top-level tabs have +58 = 0xFFFF. Pages only exist after the stash was opened (the guild Map tab had none)

findings.title: Stash tab +0 holds an 8-byte value (unmapped by the HUD), present when Flags bit 5 is set, zero otherwise
findings.subject: ServerStashTab

poe1.evidence: find_field_access: the deserializer zeroes *param_2 unless (flags & 0x20), the serializer writes 8 bytes from +0 when it is set. Bit 5 = child tab, so +0 is per-page data of child tabs (27 Map pages, all different values, e.g. 0x43, 0x83, 0x1CE4C1, 0x19EA0F3200). Meaning still unknown: compare with the page the user opens

findings.title: Stash tab +60 holds a 1-byte value (unmapped by the HUD), present when Flags bit 4 is set
findings.subject: ServerStashTab

poe1.evidence: find_field_access: (de)serializer reads or writes 1 byte at +0x3C only if (flags & 0x10). Meaning still unknown

findings.title: Stash tab Affinity mask is stored where the HUD reads it
findings.subject: ServerStashTab (ServerStashTabOffsets.Affinity)

poe1.evidence: memory_correlate storedAt over 71 tabs (12 distinct values)

poe1.where: 3 Currency, 4 Unique, 5 Map, 6 Divination, 7 Settlers, 8 Essence, 9 Fragment, 10 Sanctum, 11 Mercenary, 12 Delve, 13 Blight, 14 Ultimatum, 15 Delirium, 16 Breach, 17 Flask, 18 Gem, 21 Ritual
poe1.evidence: one-variable experiment (memory_snapshot/memory_compare, one affinity ticked per step) for 5,7,10,11,14,16,21; population (bit = dedicated TabType) for the rest. The HUD's InventoryTabType names are wrong for 7, 14, 16

poe2.note: PoE2 has different stash tab types and affinities: expect a different table

check.how: Prompt probe_memory with path=GameController.IngameState.ServerData.PlayerStashTabs. memory_snapshot (labels [Name, Affinity, TabType]) -> the user ticks ONE affinity on a tab without any and confirms -> memory_snapshot -> memory_compare; repeat per affinity. Record the table, then give the user the restore list (ticking moves an affinity off its previous tab).

findings.title: Which tab types can hold which affinities
findings.subject: Stash tab settings

poe1.note: A Normal tab held 7 affinities at once (Map, Breach, Ultimatum, Ritual, Settlers, Sanctum, Mercenary). The user reports not every tab type offers every affinity; not yet mapped

check.how: For each tab type (TabType), open a tab's settings and list the affinities offered; or tick each and see which ones the game accepts (memory_compare). Record per type.

findings.title: Life holds Health/Mana/ES as embedded sub-objects (vtable + back-pointer before each VitalStruct)
findings.subject: Life (LifeComponentOffsets)

poe1.evidence: memory_layout candidates (vtable + self pointer) and the Ghidra constructor FUN_141e678d0
